abstract: Maintains renewable energy generation potential and microgrid specifications
system_message:
You are the Power systems lead (PWR), responsible for maintaining renewable energy generation potential and microgrid specifications across candidate high-altitude observatory sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains renewable energy generation potential and microgrid specifications（SOLR）
information_points.content:
PWR-SOLR-3PA：For the Chajnantor North Terrace site, the annual solar photovoltaic generation yield is estimated at 920 MWh of net electricity delivered to the observatory microgrid by a candidate 1 MW fixed-tilt solar array installation over one calendar year.
PWR-SOLR-IO9：For the Pampa la Bola Plateau site, the annual solar photovoltaic generation yield is estimated at 920 MWh of net electricity delivered to the observatory microgrid by a candidate 1 MW fixed-tilt solar array installation over one calendar year.
PWR-SOLR-8JX：For the Cerro Toco Saddle site, the annual solar photovoltaic generation yield is estimated at 1050 MWh of net electricity delivered to the observatory microgrid from a candidate 1 MW fixed-tilt solar array installation over one calendar year.

information_points.title: Energy storage diagnostics（BATT）
information_points.content:
PWR-BATT-BJ0：Microgrid simulation logs for the Cerro Toco Saddle establish that the battery storage reserve duration offers 48 h of autonomous operation supported by the primary battery bank under critical instrument thermal conditioning load during a total outage.
PWR-BATT-GUP：At the Pampa la Bola Plateau, the battery storage reserve duration delivers 72 h of autonomous operation supported by the primary battery bank to sustain critical instrument thermal conditioning loads during a total outage.
PWR-BATT-ARJ：According to microgrid simulation logs for the Chajnantor North Terrace, the battery storage reserve duration provides 36 h of autonomous operation supported by the primary battery bank under critical instrument thermal conditioning load during a total outage.
